item.title: Dems Tour Detention Facility
item.description: A group of democratic lawmakers are touring an ICE detention center near San Antonio, today, where families caught up in immigration raids are being housed. Congressman Joaquin Castro wants to check the status of a five-year-old boy and his father, who were shipped two-thousand miles away from their Minnesota home. He says there are other kids in the same situation.

item.title: Gay Marriage Opposition
item.description: A nationwide coalition of conservative organizations have launched a campaign to overturn the Supreme Court’s Obergefell ruling, which legalized gay marriage. The group Texas Values is part of the push. Jonathan Covey says kids thrive when they’re raised by one mother and one father. In addition to court challenges, the 47-groups are working to mobilizing Christian churches to take up the cause.

item.title: GOP Battle Plan
item.description: The state’s most prominent conservative think tank is out with a plan to push Texas even further to the right. Greg Sindlear, who heads the Texas Public Policy Foundation, says their priorities for the next legislative session include the elimination of School Property Taxes. The group also wants to ban big cities from using taxpayer money to lobby state lawmakers.

item.title: Illegal Immigrant Licensing
item.description: Proposed new rules in Texas would deny professional licenses to illegal immigrants. This started at the DMV, which is looking at who can register their vehicle. But it has expanded to other state licensing, like for those who cut hair and electricians. DPS has already cracked down on who can get a commercial drivers license.
